Name: StardewGPT
Author: lorenzxl
Description:
[center][size=6][b]StardewGPT[/b][/size][/center]

[quote]This project includes scraped data from [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Stardew_Valley_Wiki]Stardew Valley Wiki[/url], which is licensed under Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0). Consequently, this software and its source code are also licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. The source code is open sources at [url=https://github.com/lorenz-liu/stardew-gpt]GitHub[/url].[/quote]

[size=5][b]Quick Start[/b][/size]

[b]Important: Configure your Cloudflare API credentials in [i]config.json[/i]![/b]

[code]
{
"CloudflareAccountId": "YOUR_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID", <- REPLACE
"ApiKey": "YOUR_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN", <- REPLACE
"ApiEndpoint": "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/ai/run/@cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b",
"Model": "@cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b",
"MaxTokens": 800,
"Temperature": 0.3,
"OpenChatKey": "K"
}
[/code]

[size=4][b]How to Get Cloudflare API Credentials (Free!)[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*] [b]Sign up for Cloudflare[/b]: Go to [url=https://dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up]dash.cloudflare.com[/url] and create a free account.
[*] [b]Get your Account ID[/b]:
[list]
[*] Go to [url=https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/workers-and-pages]Workers & Pages[/url].
[*] Your Account ID is shown on the right side of the page.
[/list]
[*] [b]Create an API Token[/b]:
[list]
[*] Go to [url=https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens]API Tokens[/url].
[*] Click "Create Token".﻿
[*]Use the "Workers AI" template or create a custom token with "Workers AI" permissions. 
[*]If using the "Workers AI" template, there is no need to modify anything. 
[*]Copy the token (you won't be able to see it again!).
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Why Cloudflare?[/b]
[list]
[*] [color=#27ae60]✔[/color] [b]Free tier[/b]: 10,000 requests per day
[*] [color=#27ae60]✔[/color] [b]Global availability[/b]: Works worldwide
[*] [color=#27ae60]✔[/color] [b]Single API key[/b]: One token for both LLM and embeddings
[*] [color=#27ae60]✔[/color] [b]Fast[/b]: Powered by Cloudflare's global network
[/list]

[size=5][b]Example Questions[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] "Do I have anything in my inventory that matches Abigail's taste of gift?"
[*] "What are the most lucrative crops to farm in Summer?"
[*] "How to catch pufferfishes?"
[*] "When can I harvest my hops?"
[*] "Where to find dust sprites?"
[/list]

[i]or simply:[/i]
[list]
[*] "What should I do today?"
[/list]

[size=5][b]快速开始[/b][/size]

[b]重要：在 [i]config.json[/i] 中配置你的 Cloudflare API 凭证！[/b]

[code]
{
"CloudflareAccountId": "你的_CLOUDFLARE_账户ID", <- 替换
"ApiKey": "你的_CLOUDFLARE_API令牌", <- 替换
"ApiEndpoint": "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/ai/run/@cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b",
"Model": "@cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b",
"MaxTokens": 800,
"Temperature": 0.3,
"OpenChatKey": "K"
}
[/code]

[size=4][b]如何获取 Cloudflare API 凭证（免费！）[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*] [b]注册 Cloudflare[/b]：访问 [url=https://dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up]dash.cloudflare.com[/url] 创建免费账户
[*] [b]获取账户 ID[/b]：
[list]
[*] 进入 [url=https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/workers-and-pages]Workers & Pages[/url]
[*] 你的账户 ID 显示在页面右侧
[/list]
[*] [b]创建 API 令牌[/b]：
[list]
[*] 进入 [url=https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens]API Tokens[/url]
[*] 点击 "Create Token"（创建令牌）
[*]使用 "Workers AI" 模板或创建具有 "Workers AI" 权限的自定义令牌
[*]如果使用 "Workers AI" 模板，无需修改其任何内容
[*]复制令牌（之后无法再次查看！）
[/list]
[/list]

[b]为什么选择 Cloudflare？[/b]
[list]
[*] [color=#27ae60]✔[/color] [b]免费额度[/b]：每天 10,000 次请求
[*] [color=#27ae60]✔[/color] [b]全球可用[/b]：在中国和全球都能使用
[*] [color=#27ae60]✔[/color] [b]单一密钥[/b]：一个令牌同时用于 LLM 和向量嵌入
[*] [color=#27ae60]✔[/color] [b]速度快[/b]：由 Cloudflare 全球网络提供支持
[/list]

[size=5][b]示例问题[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] "我的背包里有阿比盖尔喜欢的东西吗？"
[*] "夏天种什么最赚钱？"
[*] "怎么钓河豚？"
[*] "我的啤酒花什么时候能收获？"
[*] "在哪里能找到灰尘精灵？"
[/list]

[i]或者直接：[/i]
[list]
[*] "我今天该做什么？"
[/list]
